name: strip
description: One strip of quiet pills above the prompt in place of the SYS, PLAN, HANDOFF and CACHE rows: context, cache, diff, tests, agents, queue, system and peers, with a STOP and a health pill when needed. It reads the other mods' state, orders the whole band, puts one background colour behind it, and opens a context, a system and a last-turn diff pane. /strip.

rows.title: The SYS, PLAN, HANDOFF and CACHE rows
rows.description: hide: the strip stands in their place (a HANDOFF row with something to act on still shows); show: they are drawn under the strip as before. /strip rows show|hide overrides this.

transparentPanes.title: Panes without a background fill
transparentPanes.description: On: a pane any mod opens without a background colour of its own is drawn with no fill, so the terminal shows through. /strip panes clear|solid overrides this.

bandColor.title: Background behind the band
bandColor.description: One colour behind every row above the prompt, so the band stands apart from the conversation: a shade (black, crust, mantle, raised, navy, plum, teal, moss, cocoa), a colour as #rrggbb, or off. /strip band <shade | #rrggbb | off> overrides this.
